metrics.label: Population
metrics.description: Resident population.
metrics.method: WorldPop 2020 pixels summed per hex, rescaled so every district (LKA) / county (USA) matches the official 2023 estimate.

metrics.label: Land area
metrics.description: Land area inside the country boundary.
metrics.method: Sum of raster-pixel areas whose centres fall inside the admin boundaries.

metrics.label: Tropical cyclone passes (1980-2026)
metrics.description: Number of distinct tropical cyclones whose track passed within 100 km of the hex centre at tropical-storm strength or more, 1980 season to the latest (provisional) 2026 track.
metrics.method: IBTrACS since1980 list: main, PROVISIONAL and US-PROVISIONAL tracks (spurs dropped), points filtered to a box 5 deg around the country.  Wind = USA_WIND (1-min sustained, JTWC/NHC/CPHC) if reported, else WMO_WIND (agency-specific averaging, e.g. IMD 3-min, RSMC Tokyo 10-min).  A track point qualifies if NATURE is not ET (extratropical) or DS (disturbance) and wind >= 34 kt, or - when no wind is reported - NATURE = 'TS'.  Consecutive points of a storm (<= 6 h apart) are densified to <= 10 km steps (great-circle interpolation of position, linear interpolation of wind) so fast storms are not missed between 3-hourly fixes.  Count = distinct SIDs with any qualifying point within 100 km.  Exposure frequency at a point (not additive across hexes). Great-circle search around each hex centre (core.load_hexes lat/lon; land and water-ring hexes) using 3-D unit vectors in a scipy cKDTree.  Radius-based, so the value does not depend on hex size (LKA res-6 and USA res-5 tiles are comparable). 0 = no qualifying event.

metrics.label: Strongest cyclone wind nearby (1980-2026)
metrics.description: Highest maximum sustained wind (knots) of any qualifying tropical cyclone while its track was within 100 km of the hex centre.
metrics.method: Max of the (interpolated) track-point wind over the qualifying points counted in cyclone_tracks.  USA_WIND (1-min) preferred, WMO_WIND fallback.  0 = no qualifying pass. Great-circle search around each hex centre (core.load_hexes lat/lon; land and water-ring hexes) using 3-D unit vectors in a scipy cKDTree.  Radius-based, so the value does not depend on hex size (LKA res-6 and USA res-5 tiles are comparable). 0 = no qualifying event.

metrics.label: M5+ earthquakes within 100 km (1976-2025)
metrics.description: Number of magnitude >= 5.0 earthquakes with epicentre within 100 km of the hex centre, 1 Jan 1976 - 31 Dec 2025 (any depth).
metrics.method: USGS ComCat FDSN CSV (preferred magnitude 'mag', any magType; eventtype=earthquake), deduplicated by event id across overlapping search boxes.  Exposure frequency at a point (not additive). Great-circle search around each hex centre (core.load_hexes lat/lon; land and water-ring hexes) using 3-D unit vectors in a scipy cKDTree.  Radius-based, so the value does not depend on hex size (LKA res-6 and USA res-5 tiles are comparable). 0 = no qualifying event.

metrics.label: Largest earthquake within 100 km (1976-2025)
metrics.description: Largest magnitude among the M5+ earthquakes within 100 km of the hex centre.
metrics.method: Max of ComCat preferred magnitude over events counted in quakes_m5.  0 = no M5+ event. Great-circle search around each hex centre (core.load_hexes lat/lon; land and water-ring hexes) using 3-D unit vectors in a scipy cKDTree.  Radius-based, so the value does not depend on hex size (LKA res-6 and USA res-5 tiles are comparable). 0 = no qualifying event.

metrics.label: Tsunami runup observations within 25 km (1900-2026)
metrics.description: Number of NOAA NCEI tsunami runup / tide-gauge observations located within 25 km of the hex centre since 1900.
metrics.method: HazEL runups API, boxes around each country (no country filter, so cross-border runups count). Kept: year >= 1900 and source event validity >= 3 (probable or definite tsunami; seiches, doubtful and erroneous events dropped).  Each runup record counts once (one tsunami usually produces several records along a coast). Great-circle search around each hex centre (core.load_hexes lat/lon; land and water-ring hexes) using 3-D unit vectors in a scipy cKDTree.  Radius-based, so the value does not depend on hex size (LKA res-6 and USA res-5 tiles are comparable). 0 = no qualifying event.

metrics.label: Tsunamis observed within 25 km (1900-2026)
metrics.description: Number of distinct tsunamis (source events) with at least one NOAA NCEI runup / tide-gauge observation within 25 km of the hex centre since 1900.
metrics.method: Same runup records as tsunami_runups, counted by distinct tsunamiEventId instead of by record, so a heavily surveyed single event (e.g. the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami along Sri Lanka's coast) counts once.  A frequency measure, used in hazard_index. Great-circle search around each hex centre (core.load_hexes lat/lon; land and water-ring hexes) using 3-D unit vectors in a scipy cKDTree.  Radius-based, so the value does not depend on hex size (LKA res-6 and USA res-5 tiles are comparable). 0 = no qualifying event.

metrics.label: Highest tsunami water height within 25 km (1900-2026)
metrics.description: Maximum tsunami water height (runup or tide-gauge amplitude, metres) among the observations counted in tsunami_runups.
metrics.method: Max of runupHt over the kept runup records; records without a height are counted but do not set the maximum.  0 = no observation with a height. Great-circle search around each hex centre (core.load_hexes lat/lon; land and water-ring hexes) using 3-D unit vectors in a scipy cKDTree.  Radius-based, so the value does not depend on hex size (LKA res-6 and USA res-5 tiles are comparable). 0 = no qualifying event.

metrics.label: Natural hazard index
metrics.description: Composite 0-100 exposure to tropical cyclones, strong earthquakes and tsunamis, on one scale for both countries (100 = most exposed).
metrics.method: Three event-frequency inputs: cyclone_tracks, quakes_m5 and tsunami_events (distinct tsunamis, not runup records).  For each input, a hex with 0 events scores 0; a hex with >= 1 event scores the mid-rank percentile of its value among all LAND hexes of BOTH countries (Sri Lanka res-6 + USA res-5 pooled) that have >= 1 event of that hazard: (n_below + 0.5 n_equal) / n_exposed.  Ranking among exposed hexes only keeps a single storm in 47 years from scoring like a hurricane coast just because most US hexes see none.  hazard_index = 100 x mean of the three scores, so a place exposed to only one hazard tops out near 33 and multi-hazard coasts (Hawaii, Alaska, California) score highest.  The reference distribution is pooled, so values are comparable between countries (inputs are radius counts, independent of hex size).  Floods, droughts, landslides, wildfire and tornadoes are not in this index (no consistent hex-level catalogue for both countries); see the admin tables for those.

metrics.label: Deaths in natural disasters (1990-2020)
metrics.description: Deaths recorded in DesInventar datacards for natural-hazard events, 1990-2020 cumulative (dominated by the 26 Dec 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami).
metrics.method: Sum of 'muertos' over datacards with year 1990-2020, approved = 0 and a natural-hazard event type (floods, rains, cyclones, winds, lightning, drought, forest fire, landslides/slope failures, subsidence, earthquake, tsunami, coastal surge/erosion); excluded: EPIDEMIC, PLAGUE (crop pests), ANIMAL ATTACK, SNAKE BITE, FIRE (structural), ACCIDENT, Drowning, BOAT CAPSIZE, Electrocution, STRUCTURE, Wall Collapse, RETAINING WF, Collapse of building/mine/garbage fill, EXPLOSION, LEAK OR SPILL, Chemical. Grouped by district (level1 code -> COD-AB pcode by name).  Allocated to hexes by population.

metrics.label: People affected by natural disasters (1990-2020)
metrics.description: People reported affected by natural-hazard events, 1990-2020 cumulative (a person affected by several events is counted each time).
metrics.method: Sum of 'afectados' (DesInventar 'Affected') over the same datacards as disaster_deaths.  Drought datacards contribute most of the total.  Allocated to hexes by population.

metrics.label: Houses destroyed by natural disasters (1990-2020)
metrics.description: Houses reported destroyed by natural-hazard events, 1990-2020 cumulative.
metrics.method: Sum of 'vivdest' (Houses destroyed) over the same datacards as disaster_deaths.  Allocated to hexes by population.

metrics.label: Flood events (1990-2020)
metrics.description: Number of distinct flood events recorded in the district, 1990-2020.
metrics.method: Distinct (event type, date) combinations with at least one datacard in the district for FLOOD, FLASH FLOOD, URBAN FLOOD and CYCLONE & FLOOD (datacards of the same event at several GN / DS units on the same date count once).  A district-level frequency: every hex in the district carries the district's count (intensive, land weight).

metrics.label: Landslide events (1990-2020)
metrics.description: Number of distinct landslide / slope-failure events recorded in the district, 1990-2020.
metrics.method: As flood_events, for LANDSLIDE, EARTH SLIP, ROCK FALL and CUTTING FAILURE.

metrics.label: Drought events (1990-2020)
metrics.description: Number of distinct drought events recorded in the district, 1990-2020.
metrics.method: As flood_events, for DROUGHT.

metrics.label: Cyclone events (1990-2020)
metrics.description: Number of distinct cyclone events recorded in the district, 1990-2020.
metrics.method: As flood_events, for CYCLONE and CYCLONE & FLOOD (strong winds / gales are not included).

metrics.label: Disaster deaths per 100k per year (1990-2020 avg)
metrics.description: Average annual deaths in natural disasters per 100,000 residents, 1990-2020.
metrics.method: disaster_deaths / 31 years / district population (2023, core.load_admin, DCS/UNFPA COD-PS) x 100,000.  Uses current population as the denominator for the whole period.

metrics.label: Mean elevation
metrics.description: Mean height of the land surface in the hex (DSM, metres above EGM2008 geoid).
metrics.method: Copernicus GLO-90 DSM pixels assigned to the H3 hex whose boundary contains the pixel centre (H3 polygons rasterised on each DEM tile grid). Sri Lanka: native 3 arc-sec (~90 m) tiles; USA: the COG's 4x internal overview (12 arc-sec N-S, ~370 m; coarser E-W spacing north of 50N follows the GLO tiling), read with GDAL /vsicurl/. Statistics use land pixels only (DEM != 0; ocean is 0 m and absent tiles are sea); hexes without land pixels get 0 m and 0 deg. Means are weighted by pixel area. DSM heights include canopy/buildings, relative to the EGM2008 geoid.

metrics.label: Minimum elevation
metrics.description: Lowest land pixel in the hex.
metrics.method: Copernicus GLO-90 DSM pixels assigned to the H3 hex whose boundary contains the pixel centre (H3 polygons rasterised on each DEM tile grid). DSM heights include canopy/buildings, relative to the EGM2008 geoid.

metrics.label: Maximum elevation
metrics.description: Highest land pixel in the hex (peaks are smoothed by the pixel size: ~90 m LKA, ~370 m USA).
metrics.method: Copernicus GLO-90 DSM pixels assigned to the H3 hex whose boundary contains the pixel centre (H3 polygons rasterised on each DEM tile grid). Sri Lanka: native 3 arc-sec (~90 m) tiles; USA: the COG's 4x internal overview (12 arc-sec N-S, ~370 m; coarser E-W spacing north of 50N follows the GLO tiling), read with GDAL /vsicurl/. metrics.label: Local relief
metrics.description: Robust elevation range inside the hex: 95th minus 5th percentile of land pixels (drives Hills / Mountains terrain).
metrics.method: Copernicus GLO-90 DSM pixels assigned to the H3 hex whose boundary contains the pixel centre (H3 polygons rasterised on each DEM tile grid). Sri Lanka: native 3 arc-sec (~90 m) tiles; USA: the COG's 4x internal overview (12 arc-sec N-S, ~370 m; coarser E-W spacing north of 50N follows the GLO tiling), read with GDAL /vsicurl/. Statistics use land pixels only (DEM != 0; ocean is 0 m and absent tiles are sea); hexes without land pixels get 0 m and 0 deg. Means are weighted by pixel area. DSM heights include canopy/buildings, relative to the EGM2008 geoid. Percentiles are nearest-rank over the hex's land pixels (unweighted).

metrics.label: Mean slope
metrics.description: Average terrain slope of land pixels in the hex.
metrics.method: Copernicus GLO-90 DSM pixels assigned to the H3 hex whose boundary contains the pixel centre (H3 polygons rasterised on each DEM tile grid). Sri Lanka: native 3 arc-sec (~90 m) tiles; USA: the COG's 4x internal overview (12 arc-sec N-S, ~370 m; coarser E-W spacing north of 50N follows the GLO tiling), read with GDAL /vsicurl/. Statistics use land pixels only (DEM != 0; ocean is 0 m and absent tiles are sea); hexes without land pixels get 0 m and 0 deg. Means are weighted by pixel area. DSM heights include canopy/buildings, relative to the EGM2008 geoid. Slope = atan(|grad z|) from central differences (numpy.gradient) on the sampled DEM grid with metric pixel spacing (dx = deg x 111.32 km x cos(lat), dy = deg x 110.57 km), one-sided at tile edges, averaged over the hex's land pixels. Approximate: on the ~370 m US grid slopes are systematically lower than on 90 m (LKA) or 30 m DEMs, so compare slopes within a country.

metrics.label: Land cover: Tree cover
metrics.description: Fraction (0-1) of the hex covered by ESA WorldCover class 10 'Tree cover'.
metrics.method: Share of the hex's pixels in WorldCover class 10 (Tree cover). WorldCover pixels (Sri Lanka: all native 10 m pixels; USA: the COG's 8x internal overview, 0.00067 deg ~ 80 m, which GDAL built with mode resampling, so locally dominant classes are over-represented by ~1 percentage point and scattered minority classes such as built-up slightly under-represented) are assigned to the hex containing their centre (rasterised H3 polygons); fractions are over the whole hex area, so the 11 classes sum to 1. Open ocean (no-data 0 inside tiles, or no tile at all) is counted as water (class 80).

metrics.label: Cropland area
metrics.description: Area of cropland (WorldCover class 40) inside the country part of the hex.
metrics.method: Cropland area (km2) = share of the hex's in-country WorldCover pixels (centre inside the COD-AB / Census cartographic boundary union) in class 40 x core land_km2 of the hex (WorldPop pixel-area crosswalk). Border hexes therefore exclude Canadian/Mexican land; water-ring hexes with land_km2 = 0 get 0. Hexes with land_km2 > 0 but no in-country WorldCover pixel at the processing resolution fall back to the whole-hex non-water shares. Used by reconcile as the 'cropland' allocation weight.

metrics.method: Tree-cover area (km2) = share of the hex's in-country WorldCover pixels (centre inside the COD-AB / Census cartographic boundary union) in class 10 x core land_km2 of the hex (WorldPop pixel-area crosswalk). metrics.label: Mean annual temperature
metrics.description: Annual mean air temperature (WorldClim BIO1).
metrics.method: BIO1 (annual mean temperature, deg C) of the WorldClim 2.1 1970-2000 normals, nearest-pixel value at the centres of the hex's H3 children (res+2, 49 points/hex), averaged over points with data, on the 2.5 arc-min grid (~4.6 km) for both countries. Land hexes with no valid sample (coastal slivers) take the nearest valid pixel within 10 pixels; open-water hexes with no valid sample are left empty.

metrics.label: Annual precipitation
metrics.description: Total annual precipitation (WorldClim BIO12).
metrics.method: BIO12 (annual precipitation, mm) of the WorldClim 2.1 1970-2000 normals, nearest-pixel value at the centres of the hex's H3 children (res+2, 49 points/hex), averaged over points with data, on the 2.5 arc-min grid (~4.6 km) for both countries. Land hexes with no valid sample (coastal slivers) take the nearest valid pixel within 10 pixels; open-water hexes with no valid sample are left empty.

metrics.label: Population density
metrics.description: People per km² of land.
metrics.method: pop / land_km2
